mapper.select: SELECT count(1) AS totalRegisterNum, count(if(u.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate}, 1, NULL)) AS registerNum FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN tb_user_details ud ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 AND ud.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.sale_id = #{bo.salesId}

SELECT count(1) AS totalRegisterNum FROM dept_user du inner join tb_sales s on s.user_id = du.user_id INNER join tb_user_details ud on ud.sale_id = s.id inner JOIN tb_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0

select count(DISTINCT u.id) as trialUserNum, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.is_logged_in = 1 THEN u.id END) as trialLogoUserNum from tb_order as o inner join tb_user u on o.user_id = u.id inner join tb_user_details ud on ud.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.level > 0 and o.trial_order = 1 AND ud.sale_id = #{bo.salesId} AND o.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate}
mapper.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE dept_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM tb_dept WHERE id = #{bo.deptId} AND is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT d.id, d.parent_id FROM tb_dept d INNER JOIN dept_tree dt ON d.parent_id = dt.id WHERE d.is_deleted = 0), dept_user AS (SELECT DISTINCT du.user_id FROM dept_tree dt INNER JOIN tb_dept_user du ON dt.id = du.dept_id WHERE du.is_deleted = 0)
mapper.select: select count(DISTINCT u.id) as trialUserNum, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ud.is_logged_in = 1 THEN u.id END) as trialLogoUserNum from tb_order as o inner join tb_user u on o.user_id = u.id inner join tb_user_details ud on ud.user_id = u.id inner join tb_sales s on ud.sale_id = s.id inner join dept_user du on du.user_id = s.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and o.is_deleted = 0 and o.level > 0 and o.trial_order = 1 AND o.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate}

SELECT count(1) as renewalExpiresNum FROM tb_user u inner join tb_user_details ud on ud.user_id = u.id inner JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(real_end_date) AS end_date FROM tb_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND commodity_type = 1 AND trial_order = 0 AND `status` IN (1, 2) AND `level` > 0 GROUP BY user_id) o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 AND ud.sale_id = #{bo.salesId} AND o.end_date <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

SELECT count(1) as renewalExpiresNum FROM dept_user du inner join tb_sales s on s.user_id = du.user_id inner join tb_user_details ud on ud.sale_id = s.id inner JOIN tb_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id inner JOIN (SELECT user_id, MAX(real_end_date) AS end_date FROM tb_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND commodity_type = 1 AND trial_order = 0 AND `status` IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8) AND `level` > 0 GROUP BY user_id) o ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 AND o.end_date <= #{bo.endDate}

SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) AS dealCustomersNum FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN tb_user_details ud ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.is_deleted = 0 AND o.trial_order = 0 AND o.commodity_type = 1 AND ud.sale_id = #{bo.salesId} AND o.`status` IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8) AND o.`level` > 0 AND o.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate}

SELECT count(DISTINCT u.id) AS dealCustomersNum FROM tb_order o inner JOIN tb_user u ON o.user_id = u.id inner JOIN tb_user_details ud ON u.id = ud.user_id inner JOIN tb_sales s ON s.id = ud.sale_id inner join dept_user du on du.user_id = s.user_id WHERE o.is_deleted = 0 AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.is_deleted = 0 AND o.trial_order = 0 AND o.commodity_type = 1 AND o.`status` IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8) AND o.`level` > 0 AND o.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate}

SELECT ud.user_ambition, count(1) as num FROM tb_user u INNER JOIN tb_user_details ud on ud.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and ud.user_ambition is not null AND ud.sale_id = #{bo.salesId} AND u.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate} GROUP BY ud.user_ambition

SELECT du.user_id, ud.user_ambition, count(1) as num FROM dept_user du INNER JOIN tb_sales s ON s.user_id = du.user_id INNER JOIN tb_user_details ud ON ud.sale_id = s.id INNER JOIN tb_user u ON ud.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and ud.user_ambition is not null AND u.create_date BETWEEN #{bo.startDate} AND #{bo.endDate} GROUP BY du.user_id, ud.user_ambition
SELECT s.id as salesId, s.sales_name as salesName FROM dept_user du INNER JOIN tb_sales s ON s.user_id = du.user_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0

select count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o.end_date) <= 360, 1, null)) as within15Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o.end_date) <= 720, 1, null)) as within30Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o.end_date) <= 1440, 1, null)) as within60Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o.end_date) <= 2160, 1, null)) as within90Days from tb_user u inner JOIN ( SELECT user_id, MIN(trial_order) AS trial_order, max(level) as `level`, if(max(level) >= 0, MAX(end_date), null) AS end_date FROM tb_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND commodity_type = 1 AND `status` IN (1, 2) AND trial_order = 0 GROUP BY user_id ) o ON if(u.parent_id > 0, u.parent_id, u.id) = o.user_id
u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and o.level > 0 AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o.end_date) <= 90 * 24

select count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o2.end_date) >= -168, 1, null)) as expired7Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o2.end_date) >= -360, 1, null)) as expired15Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o2.end_date) >= -720, 1, null)) as expired30Days, count(if(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, NOW(), o2.end_date) >= -1440, 1, null)) as expired60Days from tb_user u inner JOIN ( SELECT user_id, max(level) AS level FROM tb_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND commodity_type = 1 AND `status` IN (1, 2) GROUP BY user_id ) o1 ON if(u.parent_id > 0, u.parent_id, u.id) = o1.user_id inner JOIN ( SELECT user_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(MAX(CONCAT(real_end_date, '-', trial_order)), '-', -1) AS trial_order, MAX(real_end_date) AS end_date FROM tb_order WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND commodity_type = 1 AND `status` IN (3, 4, 5, 8) and `level` > 0 GROUP BY user_id ) o2 ON if(u.parent_id > 0, u.parent_id, u.id) = o2.user_id
u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.user_type = 0 and o1.level <= 0 AND o2.trial_order = 0
